title: Hansen 1988 doctoral thesis
interpretation: The printed renewal f_n has one-index offset: our f_0=p_1=0, f_1=p_2=1/2. The log-convex mass and tail assumptions in Theorem2.3.2 fail at the initial index. Hamburger moment equivalence in Theorem2.3.3 is not directly applicable to this f sequence, since a nonnegative representing measure with zeroth moment0 must be0 but f_1=1/2. This does not rule out a different transformation or other classical subsumption; independent review still required.
